name: LocalAI
tagline: Drop-in OpenAI REST API replacement for running LLMs, image, and audio models locally.
real_test_summary: Tested locally on a macOS M2 machine with 16GB RAM running a Llama 3 8B GGUF model. The local REST API endpoint served responses at approximately 28 tokens per second completely offline without a dedicated GPU or external API keys.
pros: Drop-in OpenAI REST API compatibility works with existing client SDKs and apps
Runs offline on CPU-only hardware with 0GB VRAM and 8GB RAM minimum
Supports text, image, and audio inference under a permissive MIT license
cons: Multi-backend model configuration requires YAML files or Docker setup
Large Docker container images consume significant local disk space
